title: Fix Platform Hook Configurations
prompt: Fix platform hook configurations to only use native hook event names per platform spec. Remove hook configs for platforms without hook support (antigravity, codex). Fix droid to use .factory/hooks.json instead of .droid/hooks.json. Update windsurf to remove post_run_command (not in spec). Update cursor to add afterAgentResponse, afterAgentThought, beforeTabFileRead, afterTabFileEdit. Update all generators and tests. Run configure to regenerate all config files.
summary: Fixed platform hook configurations to use only native hook event names per spec. Removed unsupported platforms (antigravity, codex). Fixed droid to use .factory/hooks.json with simple string dict format. Updated windsurf (removed post_run_command) and cursor (added afterAgentResponse, afterAgentThought, beforeTabFileRead, afterTabFileEdit). All tests pass.
